subject: Greenline renewal: SOC 2 scope change, deliverable schedule & seat onramp
messages:
From: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@greenline.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Audit Team <audit@greenline.com>, procurement@greenline.com
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenline renewal: SOC 2 scope changes & retention ask

Jonas,

Hope you are well — our renewal is coming up in September and our audit team has requested a change to the log retention window for the period covered by the next attestation. Specifically, they want an extension from the current 365-day log window to 540 days for a subset of customer-facing audit logs tied to payment flows.

We need to understand:
- whether Redwood can preserve and surface 540d audit logs for the impacted services,
- what operational and cost implications that would have (storage/ingest/export), and
- whether this requires a contract amendment or a simple addendum to the current terms.

Audit also asked for a preliminary evidence package (high-level list of artifacts and access paths) to scope the work for our external auditor. I've attached a ZIP with the auditor's ask and an initial list of endpoints we think are in scope. Can someone from your team confirm feasibility and a recommended timeline?

Preferred next steps: 30–45 minute call next week to align on scope and any pricing delta. Our procurement partner is cc'd and would like to be looped in once we have a cost estimate.

Thanks,

Emma Lawson
Director, IT Compliance
Greenline Financial

Attachments: Greenline_SOC2_PrelimEvidence.zip (stated in email header)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@greenline.com>
Cc: Audit Team <audit@greenline.com>, procurement@greenline.com
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenline renewal: SOC 2 scope changes & retention ask

Emma — thanks for the clear note and the attachment. I pulled the ZIP; that helps. Short answer: we can support a 540-day retention window for the listed audit logs, but there are a couple of nuances I want to flag up front:

1) Data residency/region: Longer retention will increase storage footprint; if Greenline needs separate retention for certain regions (EU/APAC), we'll need to discuss regional storage routing.
2) Cost: There are two levers — archival tiering (lower-cost storage with slower retrieval) versus hot retention (immediate access). We'll propose both a retrieval SLA and a cost delta.
3) Evidence packaging: We can produce a scoped evidence bundle (log samples, access controls, retention proof, export playbook). That will need a short runbook exercise with your audit team to validate formats.

I'm free next Tuesday (8/4) 10–11am PT or Wednesday (8/5) 1–2pm PT for a 30-min sync. If procurement prefers, we can include our pricing lead in the calendar.

I'll loop in Kimberly and Ben to draft a proposal and term amendment options (365->540, tiered retrieval, and a seat-onramp for increased API throughput to support longer retention/backup jobs).

Best,

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Greenline: proposed term addendum + seat onramp (draft)

Jonas / Ben — following Jonas' note, I pulled together draft commercial options to present to Greenline on the call. High-level options below (pricing placeholders for internal review):

Option A — Managed retention addendum (single-line)
- Extend audit log retention window from 365 -> 540 days for the scoped log classes
- Storage: archived tier for days 365–540, hot tier for 0–365
- Estimated monthly delta: $6,800 (storage) + $1,200 retrieval SLA buffer
- Contract change: 1-page addendum signed; 30-day notice to enact

Option B — Full hot retention + throughput onramp
- Retain 540 days in hot tier (immediate retrieval)
- Add dedicated throughput capacity: +2 reserved GPU nodes for export and replay jobs (burstable)
- Estimated monthly delta: $18,500 (storage + reserved capacity)
- Contract change: term amendment + 3-month pilot period for replay validation

Seat onramp (optional)
- Add 25 additional seats for monitoring/CS access (applies to SLAs and role-based access logs).
- One-time seat setup: $2,250; per-seat monthly: $18

Attachments I will share on the customer call: retention_matrix_v2.xlsx (breakdown by log class, size, retrieval SLA)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/GL-9981 (use for deal notes).

Recommend we present Option A as the conservative path with an Option B upsell if Greenline wants immediate retrieval for the full window. Ben — can you confirm whether legal needs to sign a specific language for archival vs hot retrieval? Also, can you draft two short amendment templates (addendum and pilot amendment) for our call with Emma?

Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: retention_matrix_v2.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@greenline.com>, procurement@greenline.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenline renewal: SOC 2 scope changes & retention ask

Emma — looping back after our internal review. Per Jonas and Kimberly above, we can support the 540-day window. Attached is a customer-friendly summary we plan to walk through on Friday's call. Quick bullets to align prior to the sync: 

- Conservative recommendation: Option A (archived 365–540) to minimize cost and legal friction.
- If you require immediate exportability across the full 540 window, Option B is available (hot retention + throughput onramp) and we can run a 3-month pilot to validate audit pulls.
- Commercials: The addendum will be a single-page amendment. Procurement — if Greenline is comfortable with the conservative path, we can prepare a DocuSign addendum and pricing schedule for signature within 48 hours of the call. Link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/GL-9981-addendum

Next steps: confirm call time (we proposed Wed 8/5 1–2pm PT earlier — if that still works, we'll send a calendar invite with the retention_matrix_v2.xlsx and the draft addendum attached).

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
